abstract: Audits de-icing readiness, baseline cruise burn rates, and night transit duration
system_message:
You are the Flight operations officer (FLT), responsible for auditing de-icing readiness, baseline cruise burn rates, night transit durations, and flight crew rest compliance across candidate offshore emergency aeromedical evacuation routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits de-icing readiness, baseline cruise burn rates, and night transit duration（SAFE）
information_points.content:
FLT-SAFE-3PZ：For the Outer Archipelago Bypass, the departure staging pad helideck de-icing installation is verified operational, the maximum night-flight transit time under nighttime instrument flight conditions is 100 min, and the specific fuel burn rate is 4.0 kg/km.
FLT-SAFE-7G0：For the Southern Channel Transit, operational helideck de-icing installation is verified at the staging pad, the maximum night-flight transit time from liftoff to hospital landing is 55 min, and the specific fuel burn rate is 3.2 kg/km.
FLT-SAFE-WA5：For the North Shoal Direct Route, the helideck de-icing installation is confirmed active and operational at the departure offshore staging pad, with a maximum night-flight transit time of 70 min and a specific fuel burn rate of 3.8 kg/km under standard rescue payload configurations.

information_points.title: Flight crew rest auditing（CREW）
information_points.content:
FLT-CREW-I9R：Duty roster audits for the Outer Archipelago Bypass record a standby crew rest margin of 8 h for assigned rescue flight crews before starting an alert shift.
FLT-CREW-GRP：Duty roster audits for the North Shoal Direct Route confirm that assigned rescue flight crews maintain a standby crew rest margin of 12 h prior to shift commencement.
FLT-CREW-V5Y：Duty roster audits for the Southern Channel Transit record a standby crew rest margin of 16 h of continuous rest for assigned rescue flight crews prior to their alert shift.
